title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡~EUV multilayer mirrors
focus: 13.5 nm 反射式光學的多層膜、面形、污染與波前預算~Multilayer reflectance, figure, contamination and wavefront budgets for 13.5 nm reflective optics
summary: 從 EUV 強吸收出發，理解 Mo/Si 多層膜為何能反射、週期與粗糙度如何決定反射率，再把面形、鍍膜應力、污染、熱負載與波前誤差預算整合成可驗收的反射鏡工程。~Start from strong EUV absorption to see why Mo/Si multilayers reflect, how period and roughness set reflectance, then integrate figure, coating stress, contamination, thermal load and wavefront budgets into an acceptable mirror engineering record.

units.anchor: 反射式光路與真空腔~Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber
units.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構~Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture
units.mechanism: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。~At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well.
units.model: 單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。~A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase.
units.verify: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。~Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap.
units.failure: 若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。~Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses.
units.misconception: 只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。~With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.

units.anchor: Mo/Si 多層膜堆~Mo/Si multilayer stack
units.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件~Multilayer period and the Bragg condition
units.mechanism: Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。各界面的微弱反射在正向入射時因為光程差等於一個波長而同相疊加，形成類似布拉格繞射的反射峰；由於材料吸收，週期數超過約 50 組後反射率不再提升。理論峰值約 74%，實際鍍膜約 70%。~A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The weak reflections from each interface add in phase at normal incidence because the round-trip path equals one wavelength, giving a Bragg-like reflectance peak; absorption makes additional bilayers beyond about 50 useless. The theoretical peak is about 74% and production coatings reach about 70%.
units.model: 修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。週期誤差會按 Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d 推移峰值波長。~The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm. A period error shifts the peak by Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d.
units.verify: 用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。~After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement.
units.failure: 界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。~Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance; if the lateral period gradient does not match the designed angle-of-incidence map, different mirror zones peak at different wavelengths and both reflectance and uniformity degrade.
units.misconception: 雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。~More bilayers always give higher reflectance.

units.anchor: 基板面形與粗糙度頻譜~Substrate figure and roughness spectrum
units.title: 面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射~Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter
units.mechanism: 鏡面誤差依空間頻率分成三段：低頻的面形誤差直接變成波前像差；中頻粗糙度（MSFR）把光散射到像點附近形成眩光（flare），降低影像對比；高頻粗糙度（HSFR）把光散射到視場之外，等效降低反射率。因為波長只有 13.5 nm，可接受的粗糙度是 0.1 nm 等級，比可見光光學嚴格兩個數量級。~Mirror errors are split by spatial frequency: low-frequency figure error becomes wavefront aberration; mid-spatial-frequency roughness (MSFR) scatters light near the image point as flare that reduces contrast; high-spatial-frequency roughness (HSFR) scatters light out of the field and acts like a reflectance loss. Because the wavelength is only 13.5 nm, acceptable roughness is of order 0.1 nm, two orders of magnitude tighter than visible optics.
units.model: 總積分散射近似為 TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²；取 σ = 0.1 nm、正向入射、λ = 13.5 nm，TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087，即約 0.9% 的光被散射；σ = 0.2 nm 時約 3.5%。~Total integrated scatter is approximately TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²; with σ = 0.1 nm at normal incidence and λ = 13.5 nm, TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087, about 0.9% of the light, and about 3.5% for σ = 0.2 nm.
units.verify: 以干涉儀量面形、以白光干涉或 AFM 量不同取樣長度的粗糙度，將功率譜密度（PSD）依頻段積分成三個 σ 值，再用 TIS 公式估散射損失並與反射率量測差額比對。~Measure figure with an interferometer and roughness at several sampling lengths with white-light interferometry or AFM, integrate the power spectral density into three band-limited σ values, then estimate scatter loss with the TIS relation and compare with the reflectance shortfall.
units.failure: 拋光若只追求低頻面形而留下週期數十微米的中頻波紋，成像會出現對比下降的眩光，即使面形與反射率各自合格。~Polishing that chases low-frequency figure while leaving tens-of-micrometre mid-frequency ripple produces contrast-robbing flare even when figure and reflectance each pass.
units.misconception: 達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。~A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.

units.anchor: 濺鍍腔與膜應力~Sputter chamber and coating stress
units.title: 鍍膜製程與多層膜應力~Deposition process and multilayer stress
units.mechanism: 多層膜通常以磁控濺鍍或離子束濺鍍逐層沉積，並以石英晶體或原位反射率監控厚度；每層厚度誤差必須控制在 0.01 nm 等級。Mo/Si 多層膜通常帶有數百 MPa 的壓應力，會把基板彎曲並改變已拋光好的面形，因此需要應力補償層、退火或在設計階段預留變形量。~Multilayers are deposited layer by layer by magnetron or ion-beam sputtering with quartz-crystal or in-situ reflectance thickness control; per-layer errors must stay near 0.01 nm. Mo/Si stacks typically carry several hundred MPa of compressive stress that bends the substrate and alters the polished figure, so compensation layers, annealing or pre-compensated figure are required.
units.model: Stoney 關係給出鍍膜後的曲率 κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²)。取膜應力 σ_f = −400 MPa、總膜厚 t_f = 350 nm、ULE 基板 E_s = 67.6 GPa、ν_s = 0.17、厚度 t_s = 50 mm，κ ≈ 6×400e6×350e−9×0.83/(67.6e9×0.0025) ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁶ m⁻¹；對半徑 100 mm 的鏡面，矢高變化 ≈ κr²/2 ≈ 21 nm，遠超過次奈米面形預算。~Stoney's relation gives the post-coating curvature κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²). With σ_f = −400 MPa, total film thickness t_f = 350 nm, a ULE substrate with E_s = 67.6 GPa, ν_s = 0.17 and t_s = 50 mm, κ ≈ 6×400e6×350e−9×0.83/(67.6e9×0.0025) ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁶ m⁻¹; over a 100 mm radius the sag change is ≈ κr²/2 ≈ 21 nm, far beyond a sub-nanometre figure budget.
units.verify: 鍍膜前後各量一次面形並相減，與 Stoney 預測的球面項比較；若殘差含非球面項，表示應力沿鏡面不均勻或夾持造成變形，需另外分析。~Measure figure before and after coating and subtract; compare the difference with the Stoney spherical term. Residual non-spherical terms indicate stress non-uniformity or mounting-induced deformation that needs separate analysis.
units.failure: 忽略應力的鏡面在鍍膜後面形超差，只能重新修形並重鍍；若重鍍時週期控制又偏移，反射率與面形兩項同時不合格。~A mirror coated without stress accounting fails figure after coating and must be refigured and recoated; if period control drifts on the recoat, both reflectance and figure fail together.
units.misconception: 基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。~For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.

units.anchor: Ru 覆蓋層與氫清潔~Ruthenium capping layer and hydrogen cleaning
units.title: 表面污染、氧化與覆蓋層~Surface contamination, oxidation and capping layers
units.mechanism: EUV 光子與殘留碳氫化合物作用會在鏡面沉積碳；殘留水氣則使最上層 Si 氧化，氧化通常不可逆。因此多層膜頂部加上數奈米的 Ru 覆蓋層抗氧化，並以氫自由基清潔週期性移除碳膜。真空腔的殘氣分壓、材料除氣與光罩附近的清潔策略都屬於鏡面壽命工程。~EUV photons react with residual hydrocarbons to deposit carbon on the mirror, while residual water oxidises the top silicon layer, usually irreversibly. A few nanometres of ruthenium capping resists oxidation, and hydrogen-radical cleaning periodically removes carbon films. Residual-gas partial pressures, material outgassing and cleaning strategy near the reticle are all part of mirror-lifetime engineering.
units.model: 厚度 t_C 的碳膜使反射率近似按 R ≈ R₀·exp(−2·α_C·t_C) 衰減，其中 α_C = 4πβ/λ 為碳在 13.5 nm 的吸收係數（β ≈ 0.007 時約 0.0065 nm⁻¹）；t_C = 1 nm 時反射率約損失 1.3%，六片鏡子各長 1 nm 碳就損失約 7.5% 通量。~A carbon film of thickness t_C reduces reflectance roughly as R ≈ R₀·exp(−2·α_C·t_C) with α_C = 4πβ/λ the carbon absorption coefficient at 13.5 nm (about 0.0065 nm⁻¹ for β ≈ 0.007); t_C = 1 nm costs about 1.3% reflectance, and 1 nm of carbon on each of six mirrors loses about 7.5% throughput.
units.verify: 以原位或定期的反射率監測追蹤衰減速率，用 XPS 或橢偏儀估碳膜厚度與覆蓋層氧化狀態，並確認氫清潔後反射率是否回到基準。~Track the decay rate with in-situ or periodic reflectance monitoring, estimate carbon thickness and cap oxidation by XPS or ellipsometry, and confirm that reflectance returns to baseline after hydrogen cleaning.
units.failure: 若把 Si 當最外層，水氣氧化使反射率永久下降；若氫清潔過強，會侵蝕或起泡覆蓋層，同樣造成不可逆損失。~Leaving silicon as the outermost layer lets water oxidation permanently lower reflectance; over-aggressive hydrogen cleaning erodes or blisters the cap, also irreversibly.
units.misconception: 在真空中工作的鏡面不會受到污染。~A mirror working in vacuum cannot get contaminated.

units.anchor: 波前誤差預算表~Wavefront-error budget table
units.title: 波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準~Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion
units.mechanism: 投影光學由多片反射鏡組成，每片面形誤差在反射時加倍計入波前。影像品質以 RMS 波前誤差衡量，Maréchal 判準要求總 RMS 約小於 λ/14 才能維持 Strehl 比 0.8；在 13.5 nm 這相當於約 1 nm。各鏡的面形、鍍膜、對準與熱變形必須以均方根相加分配到次奈米等級。~Projection optics use several mirrors, and each mirror's figure error enters the wavefront twice on reflection. Image quality is judged by RMS wavefront error; the Maréchal criterion asks for a total RMS below about λ/14 to keep a Strehl ratio of 0.8, which at 13.5 nm is about 1 nm. Figure, coating, alignment and thermal terms of every mirror must be allocated root-sum-square to sub-nanometre values.
units.model: Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]。σ = 1.0 nm 時，(2π×1/13.5)² = 0.217，Strehl ≈ 0.805；σ = 1.5 nm 時約 0.614。六片鏡子若各分配 σᵢ，總和為 σ_total = √(Σσᵢ²)，且每片的面形貢獻 ≈ 2·figure_RMS·cosθ。~Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]. For σ = 1.0 nm, (2π×1/13.5)² = 0.217 and Strehl ≈ 0.805; for σ = 1.5 nm it is about 0.614. With six mirrors allocated σᵢ each, σ_total = √(Σσᵢ²), and each mirror's figure contribution is ≈ 2·figure_RMS·cosθ.
units.verify: 建立預算表：列出每片鏡子的面形、鍍膜、對準、熱與量測不確定度，計算 RSS 並與允收值比較；再用波長相同的干涉量測或系統波前量測反推 Zernike 項，核對哪一項吃掉最多預算。~Build the budget table listing figure, coating, alignment, thermal and metrology uncertainty per mirror, compute the RSS and compare with the allowance; then use at-wavelength or system wavefront measurement to back out Zernike terms and see which item consumes the most budget.
units.failure: 把 PV（峰谷）與 RMS 混用、或把同一來源重複計入兩個項目，會讓預算表看似合格但實際影像對比不足。~Mixing peak-to-valley with RMS values, or double-counting one source under two items, makes the budget look compliant while the real image contrast falls short.
units.misconception: λ/4 的面形品質對任何波長都是「繞射極限」。~λ/4 figure quality is diffraction limited at any wavelength.

units.anchor: 熱控與低膨脹基板~Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate
units.title: 熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移~Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift
units.mechanism: 每片鏡子吸收約 30% 的 EUV 以及光源帶來的紅外與帶外輻射，鏡面溫度會上升並隨曝光負載變化。基板採用 ULE 或 Zerodur 等超低膨脹玻璃陶瓷，熱膨脹係數在 ±20 ppb/K 以內，再配合主動溫控、熱感測與模型補償，才能把熱致面形漂移壓在次奈米。~Each mirror absorbs about 30% of the EUV plus infrared and out-of-band radiation from the source, so its temperature rises and varies with exposure load. Substrates use ultralow-expansion glass ceramics such as ULE or Zerodur with thermal expansion within ±20 ppb/K, combined with active temperature control, thermal sensing and model-based compensation, to keep thermal figure drift sub-nanometre.
units.model: 一維熱變形 Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h。取 α = 10 ppb/K、鏡體厚度 h = 50 mm、局部溫升 ΔT = 0.2 K，Δh ≈ 1×10⁻⁸×0.2×0.05 m = 0.1 nm；若改用 CTE 為 0.5 ppm/K 的普通玻璃，同樣條件下變形達 5 nm。~A one-dimensional thermal deformation is Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h. With α = 10 ppb/K, a 50 mm mirror body and a local rise ΔT = 0.2 K, Δh ≈ 1×10⁻⁸×0.2×0.05 m = 0.1 nm; an ordinary glass with CTE 0.5 ppm/K would deform 5 nm under the same conditions.
units.verify: 以已知熱負載照射或加熱鏡面並同時量面形，比較量測漂移與有限元素或一維估計值；檢查 CTE 在鏡體內的均勻性是否足以解釋殘差。~Irradiate or heat the mirror with a known load while measuring figure, compare the measured drift with finite-element or one-dimensional estimates, and check whether CTE homogeneity across the blank explains any residual.
units.failure: 基板 CTE 不均勻時，即使平均 CTE 為零，溫度場仍會造成非均勻變形，出現無法用整體溫控消除的像散。~With inhomogeneous CTE, a zero average CTE still leaves non-uniform deformation under a temperature field, producing astigmatism that global temperature control cannot remove.
units.misconception: 超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。~Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation.

units.anchor: 系統對準與驗收報告~System alignment and acceptance record
units.title: 鏡組整合、對準與驗收~Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance
units.mechanism: 反射鏡以撓性或運動學支撐安裝，避免夾持應力並允許微米到奈米級的位置調整；每片鏡子的位移與傾斜對波前的靈敏度由光學設計的靈敏度矩陣給出。最後以成像或波前系統量測、眩光量測與壽命外推共同構成驗收，而不是只看元件各自合格。~Mirrors are held on flexure or kinematic mounts that avoid clamping stress and allow micrometre-to-nanometre adjustment; the wavefront sensitivity to each mirror's displacement and tilt comes from the optical design's sensitivity matrix. Acceptance combines system wavefront or imaging measurement, flare measurement and lifetime extrapolation rather than separate component passes.
units.model: 若某鏡傾斜靈敏度為 0.5 nm 波前／µrad，允許該項佔用 0.2 nm 預算，則傾斜公差為 0.4 µrad；對 200 mm 跨距，相當於邊緣位移 80 nm，顯示對準機構需要奈米級解析度。~If a mirror's tilt sensitivity is 0.5 nm wavefront per µrad and the item is allowed 0.2 nm of budget, the tilt tolerance is 0.4 µrad; over a 200 mm span that equals 80 nm of edge displacement, showing that the alignment mechanism needs nanometre resolution.
units.verify: 用靈敏度矩陣把量到的 Zernike 項反解成各鏡的位移與傾斜修正量，施加修正後再量一次，確認殘差收斂並在預算內；驗收報告需同時列出反射率、波前、眩光、污染衰減速率與熱漂移。~Invert the measured Zernike terms through the sensitivity matrix into per-mirror displacement and tilt corrections, apply them, re-measure, and confirm the residual converges within budget; the acceptance record must list reflectance, wavefront, flare, contamination decay rate and thermal drift together.
units.failure: 安裝時的夾持力或黏著劑收縮會把合格的鏡面壓出像散；若驗收只核對元件報告而不做系統量測，這類錯誤會留到曝光結果才被發現。~Clamping force or adhesive shrinkage during mounting can press astigmatism into a passing mirror; acceptance that only checks component reports without a system measurement leaves such errors to be found in exposure results.
units.misconception: 每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。~If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass.

example: 波前預算練習：假設投影光學六片鏡子各分配 RMS 面形 0.15 nm、鍍膜 0.08 nm、對準 0.1 nm、熱漂移 0.1 nm。每片的面形貢獻為 2×0.15 = 0.30 nm；單鏡 RSS = √(0.30² + 0.08² + 0.10² + 0.10²) = 0.342 nm；六片 RSS = 0.342×√6 = 0.837 nm；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×0.837/13.5)²] = exp(−0.152) ≈ 0.86。若面形放寬到 0.25 nm，六片 RSS ≈ 1.29 nm，Strehl 降到約 0.70，低於 0.8 的常用判準。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Wavefront-budget exercise: assume six projection mirrors, each allocated 0.15 nm RMS figure, 0.08 nm coating, 0.10 nm alignment and 0.10 nm thermal drift. Each mirror's figure contribution is 2×0.15 = 0.30 nm; the per-mirror RSS is √(0.30² + 0.08² + 0.10² + 0.10²) = 0.342 nm; six mirrors give 0.342×√6 = 0.837 nm; Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×0.837/13.5)²] = exp(−0.152) ≈ 0.86. Relaxing figure to 0.25 nm raises the six-mirror RSS to about 1.29 nm and drops Strehl to about 0.70, below the common 0.8 criterion. Values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.
history: 1980 年代 Barbee 等人證明 Mo/Si 多層膜可在軟 X 光波段達到高反射率，使 13.5 nm 反射式微影成為可能；ZEISS 與 ASML 合作的 EUV 投影光學於 2010 年代進入量產微影機，近年的 High-NA EUV 更把數值孔徑提升到 0.55，鏡面尺寸與面形要求再提高一級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何專有膜系配方。~In the 1980s Barbee and colleagues showed that Mo/Si multilayers reach high soft-X-ray reflectance, making reflective lithography at 13.5 nm feasible; EUV projection optics developed by ZEISS with ASML entered production lithography tools in the 2010s, and recent High-NA EUV raised the numerical aperture to 0.55 with larger mirrors and tighter figure. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic, not any proprietary coating recipe.
